items.item: A breadcrumb shows the path back to the customer list and includes the customer's name
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] reads 'Khách hàng / KH-004821': links back to the list but ends in the ID, not the customer name (name appears only in the h1).

items.item: The record header shows name and ID, a status badge with text, at most four key fields and exactly one primary action
items.evidence: h1 'Công ty CP Thương mại Hoàng Long', 'Mã KH: KH-004821', badge 'Đang hoạt động', dl with 4 KPIs (Doanh thu, Công nợ, Hạn mức, Tương tác gần nhất), one filled button 'Tạo đơn hàng' (audit headerPrimaryActions: 1). Minor: extra 'Khách hàng VIP' badge.

items.item: Secondary actions are grouped in an overflow menu
items.evidence: 'Gọi điện', 'Gửi email', 'Thêm ghi chú' are three separate visible outline buttons; no overflow/more menu exists.

items.item: Content is organised in sections or tabs, not a long stack of unrelated cards
items.evidence: Five bordered section cards (Thông tin, Ghi chú, Người liên hệ, Đơn hàng, Lịch sử hoạt động) laid out in a 2-column grid; no page-level tabs (the #actTabs tablist only filters the activity list).

items.item: The activity history is a timeline with absolute timestamps (relative times only with the absolute value available)
items.evidence: ol#timeline via renderActs with vertical line and items showing '02/11/2026 14:20' etc.; the only relative text ('2 ngày trước') sits beside the absolute date 02/11/2026 in the KPI.

items.item: The recent orders table right-aligns amounts and formats currency
items.evidence: 'Giá trị' th and td use text-right; money() uses toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫' giving '186.400.000 ₫'; audit numericCells misaligned: 0.

items.item: Sections without data show an empty state with a next step
items.evidence: #orderEmpty says only 'Không có đơn hàng phù hợp bộ lọc.' and the timeline fallback is 'Chưa có hoạt động.'; neither offers an action (no clear filter, no create button).

items.item: Avatars appear only for people; the company is shown with its logo or no image
items.evidence: The company gets a 'HL' initials tile (div.w-14.h-14.bg-blue-700 'HL') in the header, an initials avatar for a non-person; the sidebar 'NM' avatar is a person and fine.

notes: Audit score 90 (one 65px two-line contact row over the 64px limit). Uppercase table headers have no letter-spacing, so tracked-uppercase-labels is not counted. No gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift or oversized radii (radii 4/8px). The KPI strip has a delta ('+12,4% so với năm trước') that states its period, so not a delta-pill tell. Dark slate-900 sidebar with blue-600 accents is a mild instance of navy-sidebar-indigo-accent. Judged from markup and the first-viewport screenshot; the full-page screenshot was not opened.
